verses.text: Haton in lesal a in Habacuc in, schekab' in Dios.
Mamin Jehová, ayik swab'an yab'ixal masanil tas a b'onak, ste sat in k'ol yuj. B'o icha tas a b'onak t'a peka' chi' t'a ko tiempoal tik. Wach'chom t'a skal yowal a k'o'ol, ch'ox ok'elk'olal t'ayonh.
Ha Dios Haxonhej Ochi, skot t'a lum tzalan Parán t'a yol yik Temán. Smakchajel masanil satcha'anh yuj stzikikial, haxo masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tz'alan wach' lolonel t'ay.
Sjawi t'a skal stzikikial. Tz'elta kopoljok k'ak' t'a yol sk'ab', sch'oxanel spoder k'ub'anel yuj.
Ha ilya b'ab'el sb'at yuj, ha t'a spatik tzak'an sb'at chamel.

Ayik tz'och wa'an, tz'ib'xik'e lum lum tik smasanil. Masanil juntzanh nación slaj ib'xik'e yuj xiwelal ayik tz'och k'elan t'a heb'. Ha juntzanh lum witz aytaxon t'a peka', slaj k'e tamaljok lu'um, slaj em lanhaljok lu'um. Yujto a Jehová wan sb'o'an icha tas sb'onak t'a peka',
yuj chi' swil yochkan heb' anima kajan t'a chonhab' Cusán t'a ilk'olal. Swilpax yochkan heb' kajan t'a chonhab' Madián t'a xiwk'olal.

Mamin Jehová, manhok t'a ha' niwak ha' ix kot owal. Manhok pax t'a ha' mar ix kot yowal a k'o'ol. Ayik ix ach b'at t'a owal yik tza satel heb' ajk'o'ol, ichato ix ach k'e t'a yib'anh a chej, mato ach k'e t'a yol a carruaje yik owal.
Ichato ix laj ik'k'eta a jul-lab' t'a yol yet'tal, yik tzach julwaj yet'ok. Ha ha' niwak ha', ix te' k'e ha', ix el ha' t'a smelemal u'uj.
Ayik ix a ch'oxan a b'a, ix te ib'xik'e lum niwak witz, ix kot niwak yaxnhab' t'a satcha'anh, ix k'anh sk'e chulnaj ha' mar, ayxo smay ix aj sk'e wa'an ha' ayik ix a ch'oxan a b'a chi'.
Ix och wa'an k'u yet' k'e'en uj ayik kopoljub' yel sk'ak'al a jul-lab' yet' a lanza ayik sb'ati.
Yet' yowal a k'o'ol ix a tek'kanem lum lum tik. Yet' pax a k'ak'alk'olal ix a tek'kanem juntzanh nación.
Ix ach elta yik tzach kolwaj t'a a chonhab' yet' t'a winh rey sik'b'ilel u'uj. Haxo winh yajalil heb' anima te chuk, ix a tek'kanem winh. Ix a satel schonhab' winh, masanto ix cheklaj yich.
Ha heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' ajk'ol chi', a yet' syamk'ab' heb' yik owal, a yet'ok ix a milcham heb' ayik ix ja heb' t'ayonh yik tzonh satanel heb' yalani.
Ichato ix ach b'ey t'a yib'anh ha' mar yet' nok' a chej, yuj chi' ix k'e chulnaj ha' mar chi'.

Ayik ix wab'an masanil tas ol jawok t'a kib'anh, ix in xiwk'ei. Ix ib'xik'e in ti'. Masanil in niwanil ix el yip, ix el pax yip in xub'. Wach'chom icha chi' ol ajok, palta niwan ol wutok in k'ol in tanhwan jun k'uhal ayik ol jawok ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' tz'ak'an owal ket'ok.

Tzin te tzalaj wal u'uj ach Jehová in Kolumal, wach'chom manh ol xumakan te' higo, manh ol satan te' uwa yet' te' olivo, manh ol yak' sat tas tz'awchaji, wach'chom ol satel masanil nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax t'a yol makte', palta ol walnhej wach' lolonel t'ayach.

Mamin Jehová, a ach tzak' wip, tzak'an yip wok yik syal in b'ey icha nok' k'ultakil chej, tzin ik'ank'e b'aj cha'anh, b'aj ol in kolchajok. B'itajokab' jun b'it tik yuj winh skuchb'an heb' sb'itan yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' ayoch sch'anhal.
